name: Sheraton Mexico City Maria Isabel
positioning: City hotel on Reforma Avenue in the Zona Rosa area of Mexico City, officially Sheraton Maria Isabel Mexico City Reforma, with Angel-view suites and penthouses, a heated outdoor pool and Zenia Spa
best_for: City travelers who want a base in Zona Rosa near Reforma Avenue and Bosque de Chapultepec
Guests who want a suite or penthouse with an Angel view

facts.text: The Penthouse is on a high floor of the Reforma Tower with an Angel view and a balcony.
The Corner Suite has an Angel view and club lounge access.
The hotel's location near Centro Historico puts guests within a close distance of the Palacio de Bellas Artes, the National Palace and the Metropolitan Cathedral.
The Angel of Independence, a victory column on Reforma Avenue, is close to the hotel.
The hotel offers views of the bustling Reforma Avenue.
The hotel has a heated outdoor pool.
The gym is decorated with bright colors and locally inspired fitness-themed murals.
The gym has a stretching zone stocked with stability balls, foam rollers, massage sticks and stretching bands.
The Sheraton Fitness Center includes a sauna.
Jorongo Bar is a festive hotel bar with live Mariachi music, Mexican dishes and cocktails.
The Sheraton Club Lounge is a space for Sheraton Club guests and upper elite tiers to work, connect or relax.
Rooms have Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience beds.

highlights.text: The Malmaison Penthouse is a two-bedroom penthouse suite in the Reforma Tower with an Angel view and a balcony.
The Marco Polo Presidential is a three-bedroom presidential suite with an Angel view.
The hotel is located in the Zona Rosa area, surrounded by boutique shopping, nightlife and restaurants.
Guests can walk along Reforma Avenue to Bosque de Chapultepec, home to a zoo, the Museum of Anthropology and Chapultepec Castle.
Zenia Spa offers sensory experiences with organic ingredients.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
WhataHotel notes the hotel sits in a busy commercial district.
WhataHotel notes the older property's traditional decor may feel dated to some guests.
